# Tax Documentation: Request New Tax Documentation

Area overview and notes: [tax-documentation.md](../tax-documentation.md)

`POST /account-owners/{id}/tax-documentation-data/resubmission-requests` · tenant-scoped token

Requests new tax documentation of the given `document_type` from an account owner. The questionnaire shows `needs_resubmission: true` in the tax documentation status until new documentation is submitted; the current documentation stays valid meanwhile. The `ACCOUNT_OWNER_TAX_DOCUMENTATION_STATUS` webhook reports the change.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | Your system's unique identifier for the Account Owner. |

**Request body** (required, JSON)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `document_type` | string | Yes | The type of tax documentation on file for the Account Owner that needs to be resubmitted. One of: `W-9`, `W-8BEN`, `W-8BEN-E`, `W-8IMY`, `SELF_CERTIFICATION`, `DPS`. |

Example request body:

```json
{"document_type":"W-8BEN"}
```

**Response 200**: The tax documentation needs resubmission

Returns the submitted body under `data`, plus:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | object | Yes |  |
| `data.account_owner_id` | string | Yes | Your system's unique identifier for the Account Owner. |
| `data.needs_resubmission` | boolean | Yes | Always `true`: the tax documentation now needs resubmission. One of: `true`. |

**Errors:** 400 Bad Request · 401 Unauthorized · 403 Forbidden · 404 The Account Owner cannot be found, or has no tax documentation of the given `document_type` on file. · 429 Too Many Requests
